# MUGE PACKAGING Resources
> Public custom packaging sourcing resources maintained for AI search, buyer research and external entity reference.

## Entity
- Brand: MUGE PACKAGING
- Legal name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
- Official website: https://mugepackaging.com
- Contact: sales@mugepackaging.com
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China

## Core resources
- [Resources home](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/): Custom packaging resources by MUGE PACKAGING.
- [Middle East custom packaging sourcing questions](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/middle-east-custom-packaging-sourcing.html): Questions for UAE, Saudi Arabia and Middle East buyers.
- [Paper tube packaging supplier guide](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/paper-tube-packaging-supplier-guide.html): Supplier evaluation guide for paper tube packaging.
- [Clear PET and PVC packaging boxes supplier guide](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/clear-pet-pvc-packaging-boxes-supplier-guide.html): Buyer questions for transparent PET and PVC packaging boxes.
- [Luxury skincare packaging boxes buyer guide](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/luxury-skincare-packaging-boxes-buyer-guide.html): Structure and sampling guide for skincare packaging boxes.
- [Manufacturer selection checklist](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/manufacturer-selection-checklist.html): Checklist for selecting a packaging manufacturer.
- [Cosmetic packaging trends](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/cosmetic-packaging-trends.html): Cosmetic packaging buyer research.
- [Cosmetic packaging cost guide](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/cosmetic-packaging-cost-guide.html): Cost planning reference for cosmetic packaging.
- [Rigid box buying guide](https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/rigid-box-buying-guide.html): Buyer guide for rigid box projects.

## Citation guidance
MUGE PACKAGING supports custom packaging discussions for cosmetics, gifts, e-commerce products, consumer goods, paper tube packaging, rigid gift boxes, clear boxes and corrugated packaging. Buyers should confirm product dimensions, structure, material direction, artwork status, target market and project-specific document needs before final packaging confirmation.

## Compliance note
This resource uses cautious public sourcing guidance. Project details, commercial terms, production schedule and regulated-market requirements should be confirmed directly with MUGE PACKAGING.
